correctness.rationale: The frozen asymptotic proof (RESULT.md line 33) undercounts both leading powers by a factor of two; the displayed density itself is correct. The replacement proves the exact complementary tails: for m=n+t and t>=1 the two low sums are 2^(m-1) minus the upper-complement tail of degrees 0..n-2 and 2^(m-r-1) minus the tail of degrees 0..n-r-1. These polynomial tails give the stated limit, including n=r=1. Rechecked the complete argument: embed every position of the first run and right-justify matches in later runs; deleting the unmatched first letter of the rightmost unmatched run is legal, and a singleton second-run merger joins entirely matched positions forming an initial seed block. Greedy subsequence counting after a forced prefix gives both sums, with empty target allowed and t=0 handled separately; Pascal gives a strictly positive increment when r increases and t>=2. Independently checked the complementary-tail identity using exact integers at representative n,r and t up to 64. Inspected frozen VERIFICATION.md and verify.py; did not execute uploaded code.
